transcript.text: momken ra2am el owner el shakhsy?

Asln el shakhsyt bta3t el owner msh btet3amal m3 el 3omla mshashan e7na dayman mohtaminn bkol tlbatek, bas ana m3ak hena w a2dar asa3dak felly tetlobo! 😊  

Law fe ay shokwa aw moshkela m3 ay tlb 2dim, momken a7welk le zmilna mn el team. Hobbt nsa3dak b ay 7aga tanya?

Ana 3andi moshkela kbeera awy fel tlb el akher w msh 3ayez atkalem m3a ay had 3adi. Momken t7awelny lel manager aw el mas2ool el kbeir fawran? El mawdou3 mosh bas shokwa, da mawdou3 msh fih wa2t w lazm yethal fawran.
Wala yehemmak ya fndm, ana htwlha حالا lel team el mas2ool w hadd hyklmk fe a2rab waqt yshalak el moshkela de. Taht amrak!
